$comment: A mock GitHub repository's issues, in the shape the GitHub REST API returns, so you can try pulling without a token. An issue with sub-issues (their `parent` is its number) is pulled like an epic. A real repository returns the same shape from the github reader in server.mjs.
name: GitHub

issues.title: Notify me when a feature needs me
issues.body:
When a session is waiting on a question or a permission and the Workbench tab is in the background, I miss it for minutes.

Track the pieces in the sub-issues.

issues.title: Show the needs-you count in the browser tab title
issues.body:
Prefix the page title with the number of features waiting on you, like `(2) Workbench`.

- [ ] Updates as soon as a session changes state.
- [ ] No prefix when nothing is waiting.

issues.title: Desktop notification when a session asks a question
issues.body:
Use the Notification API, asking for permission the first time the user opens a feature. One notification per question, naming the feature.

- [ ] Clicking it focuses the tab and opens the feature.
- [ ] Nothing is sent while the tab is focused.

issues.title: Site: architecture page diagram is cut off on phones
issues.body: On a 390px-wide screen the lifecycle diagram in site/architecture.html overflows and the page scrolls sideways. It should scale down or scroll inside its own box.

issues.title: README: document the GraphQL mutations
issues.body: workbench-web/README.md lists the queries but only names the mutations. Add one example per mutation group (features, sessions, remote).

issues.title: Pane: show the session's cost on the feature row
issues.body: Already in the browser; the Workbench pane should show it too.
